acceptanceCriteria.quote: Retries are safe. (a) Repeating `POST /api/message` with the same `Idempotency-Key` request header, for example after a network retry or a double-click, stores the enquiry **only once**: every repeat answers 2xx and no duplicate appears in the staff list. (b) `GET` endpoints are idempotent: repeating `GET /api/room/{id}` returns an identical body.
acceptanceCriteria.text: Retries are safe. (a) Repeating POST /api/message with the same Idempotency-Key request header, for example after a network retry or a double-click, stores the enquiry only once: every repeat answers 2xx and no duplicate appears in the staff list. (b) GET endpoints are idempotent: repeating GET /api/room/{id} returns an identical body.
outcomes: (a) the first POST /api/message with an Idempotency-Key answers 2xx
(a) every repeat of the same request with the same Idempotency-Key (within 24 hours) answers 2xx
(a) the authenticated staff list GET /api/message contains that enquiry only once
(b) repeating GET /api/room/{id} for an existing id returns an identical body

endpoints.request: JSON body { name, email, phone, subject, description } (description is the Message field), Content-Type: application/json; optional Idempotency-Key header (api-contract.md#L3, #L11, #L14, #L71)

rules.text: Name: required, 2 to 50 characters, any printable characters; length error message "Name must be between 2 and 50 characters."
Email: required, format local@domain.tld — must contain a domain AND a top-level domain (e.g. guest@example.com; guest@example is invalid); no length rule and no length error message
Phone: required, 11 to 21 characters, digits, spaces and a leading +; length error message "Phone must be between 11 and 21 characters."
Subject: required, 5 to 100 characters, any printable characters; length error message "Subject must be between 5 and 100 characters."
Message (API field description): required, 20 to 2000 characters, any printable characters; length error message "Message must be between 20 and 2000 characters."
All five fields (Name, Email, Phone, Subject, Message) are required (field-rules.csv column "required" = yes)
A repeat of the same POST /api/message with the same Idempotency-Key within 24 hours must not create a second enquiry and answers 2xx, like the first call
Test enquiries must use a recognisable name or subject (e.g. prefixed "QA") so staff can ignore them

gaps.value: UI valid: a form whose values are all valid (including values exactly on a boundary) is replaced by the AC-2 confirmation. UI invalid: a form with one value one character outside a boundary is not replaced by the confirmation, stays on screen and shows a validation error, as AC-3 describes for empty fields. The exact UI error text is not asserted.

testData.strategy: Enquiries are created through POST /api/message (or the UI form) with a recognisable "QA"-prefixed, run-unique name/subject (story.md#L81); staff login uses the staff account in test-accounts.csv (admin); rooms are read from GET /api/room (no room creation needed; room booking and admin UI are out of scope). A non-existent room id is chosen as one not present in the GET /api/room list.
